item.title: CD Projekt Red has announced The Witcher 3 Remastered, coming as a free upgrade to all owners next month.
item.description: CD Projekt Red has announced The Witcher 3 Remastered, coming as a free upgrade to all owners on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S next month on September 29. In a stunning conclusion to Gamescom's Opening Night Live, the developer confirmed a list of additional features coming to the game's Remastered version as well as notably enhanced visuals, which we've listed out below. There's no upgrade to the game's current Switch 1 version, though a separate Switch 2-native version of The Witcher 3 Remastered will be sold, and owners of the Switch 1 version will be able to claim this free. The remastered game will also be sold on PC via Battle.net for the first time, where it will unlock a Geralt-themed skin in Diablo 4. The Witcher 3 Remastered — and the current game, as of today — will also include access to the game's first two expansions at no additional cost. Of course, all of this precedes the arrival of the upcoming Songs of the Past, The Witcher 3's third expansion, due in 2027. For a detailed look at what we saw of that this evening, we have you covered right here.

item.title: A new LEGO city builder known as LEGO Skylines has been announced at Gamescom.
item.description: A new LEGO city builder known as LEGO Skylines has been announced at Gamescom. After a leak earlier this summer, Paradox Interactive has officially announced a LEGO version of its beloved city builder series, Cities: Skylines. Developed by Iceflake Studios, LEGO Skylines aims to allow players to build functional and logical cities, as you would in other city builders, but also push them to make something more creative and whimsical. One such example provided by the team behind the game is putting a bakery on every corner of the city, which can produce donuts using wheat provided by farmers from elsewhere in your city. Using the creativity and imagination of the LEGO brand, LEGO Skylines players will be able to build the city of their dreams — not just maintain a realistic, functioning city, but one that lets them try outlandish and absurd ideas using LEGO bricks and decorations. The game promises a "frankly absurd amount of buildings, decorations, and other cool stuff" to build cities. “Building and creativity have always been at the heart of the LEGO experience, but LEGO Skylines takes us into completely new territory,” said Fredrik Löving, SVP, Global Head of game at the LEGO Group. “Together with Paradox Interactive and Iceflake Studios, we have brought the LEGO experience to one of the world's most beloved gaming genres. From the beginning, our ambition wasn’t just to make a LEGO city-builder, it was to create a game that is considered among the best in the genre. Whether players dream of building a bustling metropolis, a quirky seaside town, or something nobody has imagined before, LEGO Skylines gives them the creative freedom and depth to make it happen.”

item.title: Grinding Gear Games has announced Path of Exile 2 1.0 has a December release date.
item.description: Grinding Gear Games has announced Path of Exile 2 1.0 has a December release date. The studio announced the long-awaited schedule update with a trailer that premiered at gamescom Opening Night Live (ONL) 2026, confirming plans to bring its free-to-play action-RPG to PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S December 11, 2026. The footage mixed together Path of Exile 2 gameplay with cinematics while promising that players will finally get their hands on a complete build just in time for the holidays. Grinding Gear revealed more information on its website, directing interested fans to register for more information. Those who do can unlock exclusive rewards. "Path of Exile 2 is a next-generation action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players," an official description on its Steam page said. "Path of Exile 2 takes place in the land of Wraeclast, a dark continent populated by unique cultures, ancient secrets, and monstrous dangers. A sinister threat, long thought destroyed, has begun creeping back on the edge of civilisation, driving people mad and sickening the land with Corruption."

item.title: Backrooms officially has a streaming release date.
item.description: Backrooms officially has a streaming release date. The breakout horror movie directed by 21-year-old-Kane Parsons is coming to HBO Max on Friday, September 25. It will debut on HBO linear channels the following day at 8pm ET. The streaming release comes just under four months after Backrooms was initially released in theaters, where it dominated the box office. It grossed over $80 million in its opening weekend and quickly become A24’s highest-grossing movie of all time. It finished its theatrical run at just shy of $400 million globally, and remains one of the highest-grossing movies of the year so far. Toward the end of its stint in theaters, Backrooms received became available to watch in extended “Everything Must Go” screenings, featuring over 15 minutes of extra footage in the style of Parsons’ original YouTube series. That extra footage is already available to watch on YouTube for free, and it's unclear whether it'll be added to HBO Max in any capacity.

item.title: Pearl Abyss has announced Crimson Desert Enhanced, a new version of the game with additional story, available free to all players.
item.description: Pearl Abyss has announced Crimson Desert Enhanced, a new version of the game with additional story, available free to all players. Simply update the game to version 2.00.00 and Crimson Desert Enhanced will be yours, Pearl Abyss has aid. So, to be clear, it is just a fresh patch for the existing game — but one that Pearl Abyss feels is so substantial that it warrants an updated title for the full game. Crimson Desert Enhanced adds new cutscenes and story moments throughout the main questline, plus voiceover support so you can enjoy the game's narrative in German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and Japanese. Pearl Abyss previously promised a summer roadmap of content that includes improvements to the core narrative – a recurring criticism of the game at launch. And of course, the Enhanced edition will include all existing updates to the game — and there have been a lot, with new bits and pieces every few weeks.

item.title: Ubisoft just announced Rainbow Six Tactics, a single-player turn-based tactics game starring 15 fan-favorite Operators from the popular long-running multiplayer first-person shooter Rainbow Six Siege. I had the chance to talk to Tactics game director Martial Potron about creating the first single-player Rainbow Six game since Rainbow Six Vegas 2 in 2008, including his thoughts on other franchises that have successfully pivoted genres, the importance of being a tactics game first, and more.
item.description: Ubisoft just announced Rainbow Six Tactics, a single-player turn-based tactics game starring 15 fan-favorite Operators from the popular long-running multiplayer first-person shooter Rainbow Six Siege. I had the chance to talk to Tactics game director Martial Potron about creating the first single-player Rainbow Six game since Rainbow Six Vegas 2 in 2008, including his thoughts on other franchises that have successfully pivoted genres, the importance of being a tactics game first, and more. First, on that tactics-genre staple of permadeath, Potron said, "We know it’s a must-have for tactical fans. R6T features optional permadeath, as well as an Ironman mode. In practical terms, Operators who are too severely injured can be permanently unavailable for the rest of the campaign. Players can enable it at any difficulty level, so they can experience the added tension of risking to lose an operator on an easier setting. It dramatically changes the way you play, because operators are unique and not replaceable. Losing a favourite or highly progressed Operator forces players to adapt their strategy and rethink squad composition." I reference Gears Tactics as another big action franchise that made a pretty successful pivot to tactics, and Potron didn't do the usual move of not mentioning anyone else's game by name, and offered this when I asked about lessons learned from other games that have dipped their toes in the tactics waters: "The key lesson is that the game must first succeed on its own terms," he said. "Tactical-game fans have very high expectations, so R6 Tactics has to stand as a strong tactics game before it can succeed as a Rainbow Six game. Our franchise competitors that ventured into the tactics genre succeeded because they combined strong franchises with excellent design, canon storytelling, and production values. "The second lesson is that a genre shift works best when it translates the franchise identity rather than simply reskinning another formula. Gears Tactics, for example, adapted executions and emergence holes to recreate the pace and aggression of Gears. Despite being turn-based, the game still felt unmistakably like Gears.

item.title: The retro-futurism of Cyberpunk 2077 meets the retro computerism of the modern Commodore 64.
item.description: When I reviewed the Commodore 64 Ultimate, I honestly couldn't believe just how perfect it was. It surprised me in ways I didn't expect, and it's truly the result of a love and respect for the brand. It's why I gave the C64 Ultimate a 10 in my review. It's a thing of beauty, and now Commodore has officially unveiled a gorgeous new update in collaboration with CD Projekt Red: The Commodore 77. The case itself is gorgeous, with the plate on the function keys now made of brushed metal. That's not a "brushed metal" finish, by the way: it's actually brushed metal. The rest of the case has been colored to match the Cyberpunk style, the Commodore 64 badge has been replaced with a Commodore 77 badge, and there are other changes that have to be seen to really be appreciated. The entire case has a weathered, suitably cyberpunk look to it, but just like with humans, it's what's inside that counts. Aside from the new look, the Commodore 77 can now run at a blistering 77Mhz, compared to the 1Mhz of the original Commodore 64. There's also 77MB of system RAM compared to the original Ultimate's 16MB. While this new speed and power is pretty impressive (for the 1980s), it does run the risk of making some of your hand-written programs run impossibly fast, but you can toggle the higher speed off and on in the menus. Hey, speaking of menus, the C77 also has a "custom Cyberpunk 2077 themed Commodore 77 BASIC 2.0 boot screen", which continues the overall Cyberpunk feel. The famous spiral-bound manual that's shipped with each Commodore 64 has also gotten a Cyberpunk facelift, and comes "packed with lore and exclusive Cyberpunk 2077-themed type-in BASIC programs." It's exactly the kind of thing old heads like me crave.

item.title: Exodus shares plenty of similarities with Mass Effect and seems to be filling the sci-fi RPG void; you won't have to wait long to play it, too.
item.description: During gamescom's Opening Night Live, developer Archetype Entertainment revealed the release date for its Mass Effect-like spacefaring RPG: Exodus is launching on April 7, 2027 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. It premiered a new cinematic trailer that showcased new characters and gameplay centered around an intelligent octopus who pilots a mech suit. Her name is Salt and she is one of several party members you'll gather in Exodus. She is an Awakened, which in the universe of Exodus are hyper-intelligent animals and wildlife who can communicate with humans. Salt will be a long-range sniper who can use an ink smokescreen to provide cover in combat. The trailer hits heavier beats that tease some of its story elements – while Salt gives the main character Jun hard time and tends to be confrontational, she's emotionally driven to protect her species and homeworld. One of the major hooks of Exodus is the scientific incorporation of time dilation and how it'll affect the story. In true RPG fashion, it'll have player choices that can change outcomes and you'll have a crew to accompany you (a Traveler known as Jun) along the interstallar journey where humanity had to flee Earth and find a new home in the great expanse. Veteran narrative designer and writer Drew Karpyshyn is the narrative director on Exodus. If you're not familiar, he worked on some of BioWare's most critically acclaimed games serving as senior writer on Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and lead writer on Mass Effect.

item.title: Here's a first proper look at gameplay from Game of Thrones: War for Westeros, the upcoming real-time strategy title that lets you conqueror the Seven Kingdoms as one of numerous factions.
item.description: Here's a first proper look at gameplay from Game of Thrones: War for Westeros, the upcoming real-time strategy title that lets you conqueror the Seven Kingdoms as one of numerous factions. Fresh from Gamescom's Opening Night Live broadcast, we have word that Game of Thrones: War for Westeros will launch in early 2027 and have a playable beta before release. More details on exactly when you'll be able to play will follow later this year. Footage shown today included numerous heroes from the HBO series in action, including Jon Snow, Jaime Lannister, Daenerys Targaryen and the Night King — who ends the trailer sat firmly upon the Iron Throne. Oh dear! Thankfully you will have your own chance to rewrite Game of Thrones' climactic battle for the Seven Kingdoms as all sorts of factions, and deploy custom units in real-time skirmish battles. A press release accompanying today's reveal also includes mention of Robb Stark, Tywin Lannister and — curiously — both Ghost and Grey Wind.

item.title: Tides of Annihilation has confirmed Resident Evil Requiem actress Angela Sant'Albano as the new voice of Gwendolyn.
item.description: Tides of Annihilation has confirmed Resident Evil Requiem actress Angela Sant'Albano as the new voice of Gwendolyn. Eclipse Glow Games announced the news at gamescom Opening Night Live (ONL) 2026. It came with a new trailer for the highly anticipated Arthurian action-RPG, giving Tides of Annihilation fans a taste of Sant'Albano's new take on Gwendolyn. "In the trailer, a distraught Gwendolyn considers her new reality amidst the ash of a ruinous London before being encouraged by the legendary Guinevere to harness the power of the Fog - a power only King Arthur once wielded - to save both London and the otherworldly realm of Avalon from total annihilation," an official description said. "Embracing her destiny, Gwendolyn takes up the sword and learns to fight alongside powerful spectral knights; this new trailer debuts the legendary Sir Lancelot summoned by Gwendolyn to dispatch enemies in spectacular style." Sant'Albano is a star with a resume that includes parts in The Nevers, and Disney's live-action Dumbo movie, but the gaming world is still celebrating her for the part she played in Resident Evil Requiem. She showed up in Capcom's ninth mainline installment as Grace Ashcroft, a newcomer to the series with a shaky voice and deadly aim.

item.title: Ubisoft has announced Rainbow Six Tactics, an upcoming turn-based tactics game starring familiar Rainbow Six Siege Operators. Revealed at Gamescom's Opening Night Live showcase, and is due out in 2027 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. It's the first single-player game in the franchise since Rainbow Six Vegas 2 for the Xbox 360 and PS3 in 2008.
item.description: Ubisoft has announced Rainbow Six Tactics, an upcoming single-player turn-based tactics game featuring familiar Rainbow Six Siege Operators. Revealed at Gamescom's Opening Night Live showcase, and is due out in 2027 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. It's the first single-player game in the franchise since Rainbow Six Vegas 2 for the Xbox 360 and PS3 in 2008. And speaking of Rainbow Six Vegas, you play as Vegas protagonist Paul "Six" Bishop in Tactics, who will command the Operators from afar. Tactics will feature 15 fan-favorite Operators from Siege, including Sledge and Ash, and it's packing 47 total handcrafted maps along with 90 minutes of cutscenes to support the narrative. It's set during the collapse of Rainbow between Siege's 10th and 11th years. Development is being led by Ubisoft Paris, makers of fellow tactics game Mario + Rabbids as well as the last several Ghost Recon games (speaking of which, it's high-time for a new Ghost Recon game if you ask me!). Ubisoft also told IGN that there is no in-game store and no monetizations. Rainbow Six Tactics includes a breach planning feature – which might trigger a memory for fans of the original Rainbow Six on PC from back in 1998 – allowing you to plan and execute synchronized assaults with your Operators. Check back later today for our exclusive interview with R6 Tactics game director Martial Potron. Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked, and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch. He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan.

item.title: Country music icon, actress, and philanthropist Dolly Parton has died at 80 years old.
item.description: Country music icon, actress, and philanthropist Dolly Parton has died at 80 years old. Her death was confirmed in a statement published by her family to Dolly’s official Instagram account on August 25, 2026. “A rhinestone life that shone bright enough for the world to see, Dolly will forever stand as an inspiration not only through her timeless music and prolific songwriting, but also her wit, warmth, and kindness that made us all feel like family. Dolly Parton’s legacy is one of love, compassion, and resilience. With a seven-decade career, she inspired multiple generations of artists and fans with her music and an unwavering commitment to making the world a better place. Her songs will continue to resonate with people of all ages, and her philanthropic work will have a lasting impact,” her family said in a press release. A small, private memorial service will be held for Dolly’s immediate family. Fans and friends are encouraged to remember her with posts on social media or by leaving a message on her official website.

item.title: The upcoming re-release of Avengers: Endgame will coincide with the debut of two flashy new popcorn buckets.
item.description: The upcoming re-release of Avengers: Endgame will coincide with the debut of two flashy new popcorn buckets. In 2019, Avengers: Endgame was released, but this was just before the big popcorn bucket craze. Now, every movie needs to have an absurd, expensive popcorn bucket themed after something in the film. The upcoming re-release of the MCU film will allow fans the chance to purchase an Iron Man helmet popcorn bucket or one based on Iron Man's version of the Infinity Gauntlet, which he uses to sacrifice himself and kill Thanos. The Iron Man helmet also projects a message that reads, "I love you 3,000." Tickets are now on sale for the Avengers: Endgame re-release. The film hits theaters on September 25 and will include roughly five minutes of new footage, which will lead directly into Avengers: Doomsday. Marvel is keeping a tight lid on what exactly this new footage will feature, but it may introduce Doctor Doom or tee up what happens with Captain America after his "happy ending" in Endgame. Chris Evans is set to reprise his role as Steve Rogers in Doomsday and most likely Avengers: Secret Wars, as well. Marvel is also boasting its new "Infinity Vision" branding for the re-release of Endgame. Avengers: Doomsday will not be getting an IMAX release when it debuts in December, so Marvel and Disney created a marketing initative known as Infinity Vision which will help promote the most "ideal" theaters for the film. It's not a new format, but a certification that elevates auditoriums that meet a quality standard held by Disney and Marvel.

item.title: Opening Night Live 2026 is upon us, and with it comes the promise of big new gameplay reveals, plenty of new trailers, and a long list of announcements. Check out IGN's live report, direct from gamescom.
item.description: Opening Night Live 2026 is over for another year, and it brought plenty of announcements, new trailers, and news on upcoming games. We've got all the reveals that matter right here, rounded up below. Highlights include The Witcher 3 Remastered, The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past, the new trailer for Final Fantasy VII Revelation, and the surprise drop of Crimson Desert Enhanced. Check below for live updates straight from Opening Night Live! ONL is over for another year! The Witcher 3 remaster is the definite standout moment, but I'm also looking forward to No Law and Crazy Tazi. What was your favorite reveal?

item.title: Prime Video's RoboCop TV show has reportedly cast Dan Stevens as its star.
item.description: UPDATE AUGUST 25, 2026: RoboCop star Dan Stevens has confirmed he's joined the Prime Video show with a social media post. Stevens took to Instagram to share a video about the announcement, confirming his involvement. He didn't have much to add, but judging by the action figure behind him, it's safe to say he's excited. "Buzz buzz..." he said. "Dead or alive, you're coming with me." ORIGINAL STORY: Prime Video's RoboCop TV show has reportedly cast Dan Stevens as its star.

item.title: Infinity Ward has pushed an unplanned update for the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta in order to quickly address fan feedback.
item.description: Infinity Ward has pushed an unplanned update for the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta in order to quickly address fan feedback. Although the first beta weekend for Modern Warfare 4 is coming to a close, Infinity Ward has pushed an unplanned update that will fix spawns. This isn't the final update for spawns as part of this beta, but is an "early piece" of a larger improvement, so fans aren't being tortured during the final moments of this beta. The fix is live in all modes besides Hardpoint, but a fix will arrive for Hardpoint as well during the beta's second weekend. We were supposed to be done with updates today…Supposed to be.We pushed out an early piece of the larger spawn improvements we’re working on. It’s live now across all modes except Hardpoint.Hardpoint changes will come in Weekend 2.Go run some matches. 🫡 This is likely just one of many fixes coming ahead of weekend two. Players have been vocal about spawn issues, the time to kill being too rapid, and more. Infinity Ward is already being more responsive and receptive to beta feedback than its previous Call of Duty game, Modern Warfare 2 (2022). That game caught a lot of flack for ignoring fans when it came to things that really rubbed them the wrong way. Although it was a massive commercial success, it remains one of the more divisive Call of Duty games in recent memory due to fans disagreeing over the direction in which it tried to steer the franchise.

item.title: NBA 2K27 is teasing a crossover with Rockstar Games, seemingly to promote Grand Theft Auto 6.
item.description: NBA 2K27 is teasing a crossover with Rockstar Games, seemingly to promote Grand Theft Auto 6. At the end of the trailer for NBA 2K27 Season 1, there's a very cryptic tease. The camera tilts down toward a purple-ish poster sporting palm trees, which looks awfully similar to the very first artwork Rockstar released for GTA 6. Seagulls and police sirens can be heard in the background before the camera pans over to an arcade cabinet. One machine has the 2K logo and the other has the Rockstar Games logo. On the screens, the words "Season 3" can be seen in the GTA 6 font and color scheme. Seasons tend to last about six weeks, so we can expect Season 3 to launch around the time of GTA 6's release in November. It's unclear what exactly this will offer, especially since NBA 2K is an E-rated game and the GTA series pushes the boundaries with its M-ratings. However, it appears to be part of a larger effort to ramp up marketing for what will undoubtedly be one of the biggest releases in entertainment history. A lot of fans have been frustrated with the lack of marketing for GTA 6 up until now. There have been two trailers and some screenshots to go along with pre-orders, but that's about it as of right now. However, things will ramp up later this week when Rockstar Games releases an extended look at the game on Netflix. Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick previously teased a big marketing campaign for GTA 6, and it seems like the decision to partner with Netflix and Take-Two's other juggernaut franchise, NBA 2K, will help emphasize the significance of this release.

item.title: Arc System Works has apologized for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' PC launch and admitted it will be "extremely difficult" to regain player trust.
item.description: Arc System Works has apologized for the troubled PC launch of Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, and admitted it will now be "extremely difficult" to regain player trust. Producer Takeshi Yamanaka offered a post-mortem on the release of the studio's new superhero fighting game during an interview with VGC. He noted that, when it comes to the content itself, fans have mostly nice things to say about Marvel Tokon, but the positivity isn't being shared by users across all platforms. "They’re playing matches every day, they’re in training mode, they’re coming up with new combos, and we see them posting those on social media," Yamanaka said. "However, at the same time, unfortunately, in the PC version of the game, there have been in-game issues experienced by many players, which we really apologise to the player base for all of these problems." Marvel Tokon brought tag-team gameplay to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S August 6, 2026. While reviewers largely lobbed high scores its way (IGN gave it a 9/10), those on PC instead took to Steam to leave reviews of their own.

item.title: Has capitalism gone too far? KFC China has just revealed the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger, and we can't help but be intrigued.
item.description: If you're a fan of strange and unholy fast food concoctions, then you'll definitely want to see what the crazed scienticians at KFC and Nabisco have concocted. Fresh off the reveal of their fried chicken-flavored Oreo cookies in China, the two companies have reversed that fusion to create the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger. This bizarre collab was revealed by KFC China on Weibo (via Dexerto). It looks every bit as strange as it sounds. The sandwich starts off ordinarily enough, with a fried chicken patty and lettuce, but it's topped with brown mashed potatoes dusted in cookie crumbles and placed between two Oreo cookie-flavored buns. Like any good fast food mash-up, we can't decide if we're grossed out by this creation or deeply intrigued. Either way, American foodies shouldn't count on being able to try the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger anytime soon. The sandwich is currently limited to the Chinese market only, with no indication of when or if it might come to the US. Will you devour an Oreo Chicken Sandwich if given the opportunity? item.title: September's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has leaked online ahead of Sony's official announcement.
item.description: September's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has leaked online ahead of Sony's official announcement. As detailed by Dealabs' ever-reliable billbilk-kun, next month's list of titles available to PlayStation Plus subscribers will include last year's Sniper Elite: Resistance, placing you behind the long gun barrel of a British agent infiltrating Nazi-occupied Europe in 1944. "A solid stealth-based shooter," is how IGN's Sniper Elite: Resistance review described the game, affording it a 6/10 score. "It fails to set its sights high enough in order to pull off a truly spectacular execution," we added. Released back in 2022, the classic Japanese role-playing game inspired Chained Echoes is next on the roster. Inspired by classics such as Secret of Mana, Chrono Trigger and Final Fantasy 4, this retro-feeling RPG proudly wears its influences on its sleeve — but is no worse off for doing so.
